official.deadline_note: SGS general international PhD (dual-semester calendar) admission deadlines are 30 June for the First Semester (October) intake and 30 November for the Second Semester (March) intake; applications submitted on a deadline date are automatically transferred to the next intake.

official.tuition_coverage_note: Recipients will be granted a 30-50% tuition fee waiver.
official.funding_period: per semester, up to 6 semesters (3 years)
benefits: Waiver covers up to 3 years (6th semester of study), subject to an annual review of the student's academic progress
eligibility: The applicant must have fulfilled the general application requirements for international students
The applicant must be a holder of a Master's degree
The applicant is from Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East, or Africa
The applicant is not a recipient of any other types of scholarship or financial assistance and should not be engaged in any type of employment at the time of application
The applicant has published at least one article in an academic journal and/or has received strong recommendations from academic institutions (e.g. Vice Chancellor, Dean, Director)
The applicant must have a support letter from an advisor/supervisor
The applicant must have a letter from the student's embassy verifying that the applicant is not a recipient of any financial assistance/scholarship/income from any agencies or government
requirements: Number of scholarships awarded depends on application quality and funding availability
Open to new students and up to first semester students with "Continue" status
Priority is given to applicants from developing countries in which UPM holds strategic importance and from academic institutions that have MoU/MoAs with UPM
Priority is given to academic staff members of institutions that have MoUs with UPM who intend to conduct research in priority areas relevant to UPM/Malaysia

Letter from the student's embassy verifying no financial assistance/scholarship/income from any agencies or government
Evidence of at least one article published in an academic journal and/or strong recommendations from academic institutions
selection_criteria: Quality of the application and availability of funding
Publication record (at least one journal article) and/or strong recommendations from academic institutions

Ensure your Advisor/Supervisor and Dean/Director of Faculty/School/Institute support your application online before or latest by 31 August 2026

official.application_route: Apply online through the UPM SGS (i-GIMS) student portal, with your supervisor and Dean/Director endorsing the application online before the closing date.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must come from Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East or Africa; an embassy letter must verify that the applicant receives no financial assistance/scholarship/income from any agencies or government.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - IGSS is for international PhD students, with eligibility defined by country of origin (Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East, Africa) rather than by a single nationality list.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Open to Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) applicants; priority to academic staff of MoU/MoA partner institutions intending to conduct research in priority areas relevant to UPM/Malaysia.
official.research_requirement: At least one article published in an academic journal and/or strong recommendations from academic institutions (Vice Chancellor, Dean, Director), plus a support letter from an advisor/supervisor.
official.duration: Up to 3 years (6th semester of study), subject to an annual review of the student's academic progress
official.description: The School of Graduate Studies of Universiti Putra Malaysia offers the International Graduate Student Scholarship (IGSS) as a financial incentive for PhD students with excellent academic records from Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East and Africa, granting a 30-50% tuition fee waiver. Funds are available depending on application quality and funding availability.
official.english_requirement: Per SGS admission rules: a full offer requires IELTS Band 6.5, TOEFL iBT 63 (Section 4), MUET Band 4.0, PTE 63, Cambridge Linguaskill 176 (CALC, UPM only) or completed CIEP 109. International applicants may apply without a proficiency score and receive a provisional offer, but must submit a valid score on registration in PutraENROLL. IELTS Indicator, Aptis, Duolingo, TOEFL ITP and Medium of Instruction (MoI) letters are not accepted; scores must be within two years of validity.

applicant_utility.summary: IGSS is a tuition-only award: it waives 30-50% of UPM doctoral tuition fees and provides no stipend, no living costs and no travel money, so you must self-fund the remaining 50-70% of tuition plus all living expenses in Serdang. The published window for First Semester 2026/2027 ran 01-31 August 2026 and is now closed, and the SGS page has not yet posted the next round, so confirm the new cycle by email to sgs.financialaid@upm.edu.my before investing in documents. Eligibility is geographically restricted to applicants from Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East and Africa, and two hard gates decide most files: the embassy letter proving you receive no government or agency support, and the online endorsement of your application by a UPM supervisor and your Dean/Director. Holding any other scholarship or being employed when you apply disqualifies you outright, and continuation past each year depends on your academic progress review.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Academic staff or recent masters graduates from an Asian, African or Middle Eastern university - ideally one with an MoU/MoA with UPM - who hold a master's degree and at least one journal publication, have no other scholarship and no employment, and can fund the non-waived tuition and their living costs.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure a willing UPM PhD supervisor early: their support must be given online in the i-GIMS portal, not merely promised by email.
Ask your faculty's Dean or Director to endorse the application online before the closing date - this is a workflow step inside the portal, not an attachment.
Start the embassy letter at least 4-8 weeks ahead: it must state that you receive no financial assistance, scholarship or income from any agencies or government.
Assemble proof of your master's degree award and transcripts, and evidence of your publication (DOI or journal details, not just a CV line).
Confirm you hold no other scholarship and no employment on the application date, and that your institution has (or could pursue) an MoU/MoA with UPM.
Watch the SGS IGSS page and the SGS announcements from mid-year, since the one published window ran in August for the October intake.
common_rejection_risks: Late or incomplete submission - SGS states these are not processed and that appeals will not be entertained.
Missing the embassy no-income letter or a supervisor support letter, which are explicit eligibility conditions.
Being employed or holding any other scholarship/financial assistance at the time of application.
A weak publication record and no MoU/MoA link with UPM, which places you behind priority applicants.
Assuming the waiver is a full scholarship: candidates who cannot fund the remaining tuition, living costs and any English bridging course rarely complete registration.
Losing the award in the annual progress review, which ends the waiver before the sixth semester.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The 50-70% of tuition the waiver does not cover, plus living costs in Serdang, visa and insurance charges, flights, and any Certified Intensive English Programme (CIEP) fees, which SGS states must be paid in full and separately from academic tuition. The IGSS page publishes no monetary figures, so check the current international PhD tuition fee schedule on the SGS tuition fees page for the exact per-semester rate.
document_audit: The embassy letter is issued by a third party on their own timetable - request it first and confirm it names 'financial assistance/scholarship/income from any agencies or government'.
Supervisor and Dean/Director support are online workflow actions in i-GIMS; if they are not completed inside the window, the file is incomplete regardless of your attachments.
Provide verifiable publication evidence (DOI, journal, date) rather than an unverifiable claim.

You may apply without an English test score (provisional offer), but a valid accepted score must be uploaded at registration in PutraENROLL - Duolingo, IELTS Indicator, TOEFL ITP and MOI letters are not accepted, and scores older than two years are invalid.
A publication or recommendation alone does not replace the embassy letter; SGS treats each as a separate requirement.
alerts: The only advertised IGSS window (01-31 August 2026) has closed and the page, last updated 02 July 2026, has not published the next round - do not rely on catalogue listings that show the scheme as open.
IGSS timings do not match the general admission calendar: international PhD admission deadlines are 30 June (October intake) and 30 November (March intake), while IGSS advertising ran in August.
The waiver is reviewed annually; a lapse in academic progress ends the fee waiver even if you are still within the six-semester window.

If you lack an accepted English score you can be admitted provisionally, but you must sit the PTEST and complete CIEP levels at your own cost before taking academic courses, which affects both finances and visa duration.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the online form in the UPM i-GIMS student portal, have your supervisor and Dean/Director endorse it online before the closing date, then await SGS screening for completeness and award against the number of scholarships available.
